North,Ⓒs.ⒹuttarA, udIcI, uttaradiS-diSA, uttarASA, kOberI; ‘to the n(orth)’ uttaraM (with abl.), uttarataH (with gen.); ‘facing the n(orth)’ udaNmuKa a. (KI f.).
Ⓝ[North]erly, [North]ern,Ⓒa.Ⓓuttara, udIcIna, uttara-sTa, udIcya, udac; ‘in a n(ortherly) direction’ uttareRa (with acc. or gen.); ‘n(orth)-east’ uttarapUrvA, pUrvottarA, ESAnI, prAguttarA, prAgudIcI; (a.; (north-east)erly, (north-east)ern), prAguttara, pUrvottara, prAgudIcIna; pUrvottarasTa; ‘n(orth)-pole’, ‘n(orth)-star’ DruvaH; ‘n(orth)-west’ uttarapaScimA, vAyavI; (a.; (north-west)erly, (north-west)ern) vAyava, vAyudiksTa.
Ⓝ[North]ward,Ⓒa.Ⓓuttara, uttaradiksTa.
Ⓝ[North]wards,Ⓒadv.ⒹuttarABimuKaM, uttarataH, uttareRa, uttara-diSi.
